title: Approval
description: Identifies a provider-managed approval and may carry a snapshot of its state. Used as the IntentResult of `GetApproval` and as input to `ViewApproval` and `ReviewApproval`. A minimal navigation reference requires only `id.approvalId` and `provider`; `status` and related snapshot fields are omitted until a state snapshot is included.

id.title: Approval identifiers
id.description: FDC3 context `id` map. `approvalId` is required and is the durable identifier assigned by the provider. `requestId` may echo the original caller correlation identifier.

approvalId.title: approvalId
approvalId.description: Durable identifier assigned by the provider.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Configured service identifier used to resolve the approval, including its environment. Not an arbitrary endpoint to trust. Distinct from an FDC3 app ID: an app handles desktop interaction, while a service owns the durable decision.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Reference to the reviewed subject and version.

status.title: Status
status.description: State snapshot. Omitted in a minimal navigation reference. The initial lifecycle is `pending` followed by one terminal outcome (`approved`, `rejected`, `cancelled`, or `expired`). Terminal approvals are not reopened.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: Time of the state snapshot, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

expiresAt.title: Expires at
expiresAt.description: Effective expiry assigned by the provider, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

decisionReason.title: Decision reason
decisionReason.description: Explanation accompanying the final outcome, where appropriate to disclose.
